title: Try what-if changes in the Solver and save them as a scenario
summary: Try what-if changes in the Solver, watch Plan Confidence react, and save the version you like as a scenario.

chapters.label: The Solver tries what-if changes and shows the impact right away.
What if Mark and Laura both retire at 62 instead of 65?
Plan Confidence drops. Each figure shows the change from the base plan.
Trim their retirement spending to $125,000 a year.
That wins back much of the drop.
And Laura works two more years, until 64.
The plan is nearly back where it started.
Save these changes as a scenario and give it a name.
The dialog lists every change the scenario keeps.
Open the Scenario changes tab and pick the scenario.
Each change shows its base value and its new one.

steps: **Open the Solver.** From a client, choose **Solver** in the top bar. The strip under the chart shows **Plan Confidence**, **Portfolio at Retirement**, **Ending Portfolio Assets**, **Lifetime Taxes** and **Total to Heirs** for the plan as it stands.

**Change an assumption.** Use the **−** and **+** buttons beside a field, for example **Retirement Ages**. The figures recalculate after each change, and each one shows how far it moved from the base plan.

**Keep adjusting until the plan works.** Lowering **Retirement Living Expenses** or moving a retirement age later wins confidence back. A **Reset to** link under a changed field puts it back to its base value.
**Save it as a scenario.** Select **Save as scenario…**, type a **Name**, and check the list of changes the scenario will keep. Then select **Save scenario**.
**Review the changes.** Open the **Changes** tab on the left and pick the scenario from the **Scenario** list. Each change shows its base value and its new one.
goodToKnow: Changes in the Solver don't touch the base plan. Only **Save to base facts** writes them there.
Plan Confidence comes from a fresh Monte Carlo run each time, so a saved scenario can read a point or two different from what the Solver showed before saving.
Each change on the **Changes** tab has a switch. Turn one off to see the plan without it.
